scope: Actual full App and React StrictMode, shared production inventory/controller/parser/review UI; IPC and directory chooser controlled by the test harness. No installed native app, Agent, credential or official configuration call.

checks.name: opening and querying do not inspect or write
inspect refers only to exact inventory/item with no config or secret input
review and heading Enter cannot dispatch confirmation
review distinguishes user preference, directory report, profile scope and unverified connections
MCP review has no skill-specific explanation
narrow actual dialog remains in viewport without horizontal overflow
review withdrawal returns focus to the exact MCP status action
reopening a withdrawn review cannot restore authority
one explicit confirmation sends only one review identity
uncertain write remains unknown and old configuration report is stale
explicit recheck targets old operation under a fresh request without a second write
matching recheck remains observation, not previous-write success
kind A-B-A cannot confirm stale MCP review or reuse its inventory
late A confirmation cannot enter B
A result stays scoped to original directory without renewed confirm
NEW-16 explains refusal without inventing a program selection change
explicit capability refresh does not auto-query or reissue a write
separate explicit query restores review access after capability refresh
no unexpected IPC, skill writes, Agent prompt, or connection dispatched
draft and new-conversation directory preserved
